Loss-of-function mutations in FLVCR1 disrupt photoreceptor and neuronal function, leading to retinitis pigmentosa and ataxia. Concurrently, loss-of-function mutations in PPOX impair heme biosynthesis, causing the accumulation of protoporphyrin IX. This accumulation disrupts cellular respiration, which in turn negatively impacts neuronal and photoreceptor function, converging on similar downstream cellular pathways affected by FLVCR1 dysfunction. The accumulation of protoporphyrin IX also directly contributes to the photosensitivity and abdominal pain phenotypes seen in variegate porphyria.

partners.mechanism_chain: FLVCR1 (HGNC:29494) —DISRUPTS→ heme biosynthesis (REACT:REACT-71182); FLVCR1 (HGNC:29494) —LEADS_TO→ Ataxia (HP:0001251); FLVCR1 (HGNC:29494) —LEADS_TO→ Retinitis Pigmentosa (HP:0000506); PPOX (HGNC:9204) —DISRUPTS→ protoporphyrin IX (CHEBI:17513); protoporphyrin IX (CHEBI:17513) —INCREASES→ heme biosynthesis (REACT:REACT-71182); heme biosynthesis (REACT:REACT-71182) —LEADS_TO→ Abdominal pain (HP:0002094); heme biosynthesis (REACT:REACT-71182) —LEADS_TO→ Neuropathy (HP:0000757).
